framework.name: Problem-Solution product promo (Hook-Pain-Demo-Proof-Brand)
framework.description: Question hook, quantified pain (11 hours / 38 taps), product intro, three-token input, 10-second result, change-of-plan proof, before/after, brand sign-off.

hook.first_words: Where to next Anywhere Planning one weekend away takes 11 hours and
hook.pattern: 'Where to next?' / 'Anywhere.' then a quantified pain statement

structure.purpose: question and one-word answer on the flap board
planning a weekend takes 11 hours and 38 taps
Meet Fairwind: just tell it where, when and how much
devices: rule of three (where, when, how much)

structure.purpose: whole trip in 10 seconds: flights, stay, dinner, booked and under budget
change of plans? just say it (voice input)
11 hours -> 10 seconds, brand name and tagline

signature_phrases: Just tell it where, when, and how much.

retention.pattern_interrupts: Dark-to-light flip at 1.47 s, whip at 17.15 s, strike-through number swap at about 21 s.

evidence.claim: Specific pain numbers; '38' is the top emphasised word at 4.74 s
evidence.quote: Planning one weekend away takes 11 hours and 38 taps.

evidence.claim: Product intro with rule of three, matches on-screen headline at 9.3 s
evidence.quote: Just tell it where, when, and how much.

evidence.claim: Benefit stack with 10 s timer on screen
evidence.quote: It builds your whole trip in 10 seconds.

evidence.claim: Before/after and tagline close; 'Fairwind.' emphasised at 22.1 s
evidence.quote: 11 hours. Now 10 seconds. Fairwind. Go anywhere.

notes: Beat times are anchored on on-screen frames and scene cuts (pack has no per-sentence times), accuracy about +-0.7 s. Product 'Fairwind' is an in-reel brand.
